content.text: Co-sleeping at 5 is really common, and kids this age do well with a gradual change they get a say in. Tonight, tell Milo the plan in the daytime. Then do the same bedtime routine in his own bed, and stay in the room, sitting on a chair next to the bed, until he's drowsy. If he comes to your bed overnight, walk him back calmly with as little talk as you can. A sticker chart for staying in his bed can help at this age.
